origin_result.basis: Final manufacture in the UAE: PASS. Minimal operations: PASS. CTSH: PASS - all 3 non-originating inputs classified outside subheading 761010. VA: PASS - build-down 49.0% against threshold of 45% on FOB basis.

procedure.step: Register the factory with the Ministry of Economy and Tourism through its Factory Registration service: the factory must be outside a free zone, hold a MoIAT industrial licence, and provide a MoIAT letter confirming 40% domestic value added; processing takes about 3 working days.
procedure.authority: the Ministry of Economy and Tourism

procedure.step: Apply for the Certificate of Origin for India through the Ministry of Foreign Trade e-service: log in to the ministry e-services portal, choose the Certificate of Origin for India service, fill in the application form, upload proof of factory registration and the commercial invoice (plus the factory's purchase invoice if a trading exporter), pay the fee online, and submit; processing takes about one working day.

The certificate must be issued before, at, or within 5 working days of export, is valid for 12 months from issue, and covers one import only; it may be issued retrospectively up to 12 months from shipment marked ISSUED RETROSPECTIVELY.
Pay the certificate fee: AED 50 for an invoice value up to AED 100000 (fee range AED 10 to AED 200).

Ship the goods directly from the UAE to India; transit through another country is allowed only under customs control with no operations beyond unloading, reloading and storage. If the invoice is issued by a third party, indicate third-party invoicing.

The Indian importer claims the CEPA rate when filing the bill of entry, holds origin information including which origin criterion is claimed, keeps supporting documents for at least 5 years from filing, and answers customs requests within 10 working days.

Keep origin records, including the cost breakdown, for at least 5 years starting from the end of the calendar year of the certificate's issue; refusing a verification visit is grounds for denying preferential benefits.

caveats.note: The '+' in the rule PSR-IN-R118 is read as 'and' (both tests must pass); the agreement does not define '+', so this is Mansha's interpretation.
Final manufacture in the UAE and operations beyond minimal operations are the exporter's own declaration.
India charges duty on the assessable (CIF) value at import, so actual amounts will differ from the estimate shown.
CEPA rates reduce Basic Customs Duty (BCD) only; IGST, GST compensation cess, Social Welfare Surcharge and any anti-dumping or safeguard duty still apply.
Free-zone producers are likely not eligible because Factory Registration requires a factory outside a free zone; confirm with the Ministry of Economy and Tourism.

No official page read names the Ministry of Foreign Trade as the issuer of the India CEPA certificate specifically: its service page covers preferential certificates in general, and the India-specific page is still on moet.gov.ae.
Electronic certificates are reportedly accepted and uploaded to e-Sanchit, but this rests on a secondary source (CBIC Instruction 28/2022 read via LiveLaw/taxmann).
